rounds.text: While the headline valuation appears discounted, the fundamental earning power of KJMC Corporate Advisors (India) Ltd is chronically weak, as evidenced by a meager 10-year median return on equity of just 2% [E26] and a low 3-year average ROE of 2.98% [E54]. This subpar capital allocation is further underscored by a recent annual ROCE of only 5.8% [E12], demonstrating that the business struggles to generate meaningful returns on its capital base despite low debt levels. Furthermore, the company's operating-margin trend is flagged as inconsistent over both the last three years and the last three quarters [E32, E33], highlighting underlying volatility in core profitability. Conceded: the company boasts strong recent profit and sales growth alongside high operating cash conversion for Mar 2026 [E17, E21, E34, E56, E58]. However, this explosive short-term momentum clashes against a stagnant 1-year share price growth of 0% [E25] and a low-confidence rules-based screen score of 67 out of 100 [E55].
